## Concours-Level Care for Every Vehicle

StreetWorks Exotics is excited to bring its renowned, concours-level automobile detailing services to drivers across southeast Wisconsin. For years, we’ve been the trusted choice of collectors and celebrities who demand perfection for their multi-million-dollar Ferraris, Lamborghinis, and vintage Rolls-Royces—vehicles that regularly earn Best in Show at Pebble Beach and Amelia Island.

Today, that same obsessive, no-compromise approach is available to anyone in Milwaukee, Waukesha, Brookfield, Mequon, and the surrounding communities—whether you drive a daily commuter, a family SUV, or a weekend sports car.

## Premium Detailing Services

Our detailing goes far beyond a typical wash and wax. Using only the finest Swissvax, Gtechniq, and XPEL-certified products trusted on seven- and eight-figure cars, we offer paint correction that removes swirl marks and restores deep gloss, ceramic coatings with up to 10-year warranties, full interior rejuvenation with premium leather conditioning and odor elimination, and PPF (paint protection film) installation in our dust-free, climate-controlled booth. Every vehicle receives the same multi-stage decontamination, clay-bar treatment, and hand-polishing process we use on cars worth more than most homes.

## Why StreetWorks Is Different

What makes StreetWorks detailing different is the level of care forged from working on irreplaceable classics and modern hypercars. We treat your Tesla, Porsche, or even your well-loved Jeep with the same reverence—because we know how much your car means to you. We document every step with high-resolution photos, protect sensitive surfaces with painter’s tape and plastic sheeting just like we do on a 250 GTO, and finish with a final inspection under dedicated LED lighting to guarantee flawless results.
